steps.description: Start a clean iOS Simulator session and confirm the device is ready for automation

Capture the success state and dismiss the sheet by returning to Inventory home

flows.name: PC Filters – Refresh Filter Counts After Product Update

steps.description: Start a clean iOS Simulator session and confirm the device is ready for automation
Install and launch the Toast Operator build on the simulator
Sign in with the configured QA account and reach the signed-in home experience
Navigate to the Inventory tab from the main operator shell
Open Product Catalog from Inventory home — tap View all on the preview card
Confirm catalog list loads with search bar visible
Tap the 'Low stock' quick-filter chip to filter the catalog list to low-stock items only
Record the current filter count shown on the Low stock chip (e.g. 'Low stock (12)') as the baseline
Open the first product in the filtered list, read its par max value, set the current count above par max, and save — this moves the product out of Low stock
Without performing a pull-to-refresh, verify the filter count on the Low stock chip has updated automatically to reflect the product change (AC: filter counts refresh instantly)

validations: Low stock filter chip is tappable and filters the product list
Filter count badge is readable from the chip label
After editing a product, the catalog filter count updates without requiring pull-to-refresh
The filtered list remains active after saving product edits
